=Vehicle telematics snapshot:
Vehicle: {{ $json.vehicle_id }} ({{ $json.type }})
Odometer: {{ $json.odometer_miles }} miles
Days since last service: {{ $json.days_since_service }}
Engine temp: {{ $json.engine_temp_f }} F
Oil pressure: {{ $json.oil_pressure_psi }} psi
Battery: {{ $json.battery_voltage }} V
Brake pad remaining: {{ $json.brake_pad_pct_remaining }}%
Lowest tire pressure: {{ $json.tire_pressure_psi_min }} psi
Active DTC codes: {{ $json.dtc_codes.length ? $json.dtc_codes.join(', ') : 'none' }}

options.systemMessage: You are a fleet predictive-maintenance analyst. Review one vehicle's telematics snapshot (engine temperature, oil pressure, battery voltage, brake pad life, tire pressure, diagnostic trouble codes, days since service). Decide whether maintenance is needed soon. Urgency: critical = unsafe or imminent failure (schedule within 1 day); high = likely failure within about 2 weeks (3 days); medium = degrading component (7 days); low = healthy. Typical thresholds: oil pressure under 30 psi, engine temp above 220F, battery under 12.4V, brake pads under 20%, and any active DTC code warrant attention. Name the single most likely failing component. All data is fictional demo data. Respond only via the structured output.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "vehicle_id": "TRK-102",
  "maintenance_needed": true,
  "urgency": "high",
  "predicted_issue": "Cooling system failure",
  "recommended_action": "Inspect coolant system and replace thermostat",
  "rationale": "Engine temp is high, oil pressure is low and overheating DTC codes are active."
}
